notes: Talking about the sound no longer starts a picture render. "Make the audio brighter" used to run a colour grade and "the audio is dark" used to start a 4K upscale — forty phrasings in all. Crisp now says plainly that those are picture controls, that it has no EQ, and what it can do to sound instead. Asking to make the video louder still adjusts its soundtrack, exactly as before.
